_note: W24-01, 2026-09-19. The wave 24 photo slot ledger. Every placeholder wave 24 renders has exactly one row here, and every row here is rendered by a built page. scripts/check-photo-slots-w24.js holds both directions against dist/ and fails on either. This file is the input the photo session is handed: it is what a photographer is given, so 'shows' is written for a person with a camera, not for a developer. A row is added in the same commit as the placeholder that renders it, which is why this file starts empty: W24-01 ships the component, the ledger and the gate, and the first rows arrive with W24-04. build.js refuses to render a placeholder whose slot id has no row here.

_schema.id: The slot id, printed inside the placeholder box. Uppercase, digits and hyphens only.
_schema.page: The site path the placeholder renders on, locale-independent where the two locales share a slot.
_schema.ratio: The aspect ratio, written as a CSS aspect-ratio value, for example "1 / 1". This is the one place a ratio is written; the stylesheet reads it through --ph-ratio.
_schema.min_px: The minimum pixel size of the delivered photograph, written WIDTHxHEIGHT.
_schema.shows: What the photograph must show, in plain words, for the person taking it.
_schema.state: Either "placeholder" or "filled". W25-01. A filled slot renders a real <picture>; a placeholder slot renders the .ph box. Every slot ships "placeholder" until an image that satisfies R-W lands for it. W25-R4: a slot with no compliant image STAYS a placeholder, never a near match.
_schema.provenance: Only on a filled slot, and required there. The repo-relative path of the canonical image file, which is the key of its row in docs/assets/PROVENANCE.md. Gate 19 reads that row and fails if it is missing, if its host is forbidden, or if its licence does not name an approved origin.
_schema.alt: Only on a filled slot, and required there. The alt text, per locale. On an AI generated image it describes the material or the product and never claims a finished Rapid Construct job (W25-R3).
